prediction_policy.recommended_default: For completed, protocol-frozen evaluations, retain per-query metrics, denominators/counts, configuration/query/model/scorer/GT identities, and exact task-sufficient compact predictions. Keep detailed tensors for a declared fixed diagnostic sample and selected failure cases; failure diagnostics must not become post-hoc tuning evidence. For active score/readout studies retain their explicitly declared dense parent tensors.

task_sufficient_payloads.scannet: Exact per-Gaussian class-label vector separately for every declared class subset and arm, observed mask and shared immutable geometry/point mapping; one full-menu argmax cannot substitute for each subset.
task_sufficient_payloads.nvos: Retain FP32 response and retained_response for exact threshold/resize/ranking metrics, plus exact selected count. Pack selected bits for recoverable membership visualization; omit dense Gaussian scores only after auditing consumers.
task_sufficient_payloads.lerf: Keep fixed scored per-query metrics and any required exact projected masks/responses for replay, plus a declared diagnostic set. Dense Gaussian scores are still needed for new camera/readout experiments; explicitly classify such parents rather than permanently saving every variant.
task_sufficient_payloads.uqis: Benchmark-point scores/selections already exist; full-Gaussian detailed output can be bounded diagnostics when no later analysis consumes it.

not_lossless_claims: Metrics alone reproduce reported values, not independent rescoring or new thresholds.
Binary masks are insufficient for AP/ranking or changed thresholds; FP16 score quantization can change ties/ranking and is not lossless.
A summary-only file cannot silently replace a v1 predictions.pt whose archived SHA is referenced.
prediction_policy.existing_migration: First offer lossless chunk/content-addressed storage for repeated geometry/observed/query vectors and identical score tensors; pack booleans losslessly. For evidence retirement, publish an explicit reduced-evidence manifest bound to the original prediction SHA and exact retained metrics, validate fixed-protocol rescoring on a small cohort, then seek exact old-payload deletion approval. Do not retrofit old manifests silently.

initial_policy.finding: initial.pt is compiled geometry/native semantic/native local/observed state. Native channels use only train frames; development views are excluded from accumulation. train currently verifies and loads the archive before seeded group projection.
initial_policy.not_safely_regenerated_from_compiled_vie: Initial accumulates FP32 raw-projection pixel values, whereas stored view semantic/local pixels are FP16 and operator/mass differ from the original raw operator representation. Rebuilding from saved view tensors is not guaranteed bit-exact; re-running encoders/rendering additionally depends on environment and arithmetic order.
initial_policy.preferred_fix: Store nested initial tensors by exact content-address, sharing identical geometry/native/observed tensors with field packages. Keep an observations-specific manifest for split/source/encoder/row identities. Add a versioned old initial archive SHA -> exact state/store resolver for train, retain explicit v1 export for frozen code.
initial_policy.selection_safety: Do not reuse by scene name alone or include development frames to save storage. Match actual dtype/shape/value/row identities and preserve each experiment's train/development split and source receipt.
